description:
Outcome: Teacher completes v1 find/lend/return journey with restart retention, from owner scope and delegated UI choice.
Scope: Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript served by existing Node server, local-only bind, catalogue search/add, loan date entry, availability and return controls, accessible labels/focus/keyboard, escaped content and clear recovery. Update README to match actual delivered features and document local operation/privacy/backups. Add GET / HTTP 200 and then enable VERIFY with npm start and http://localhost:3000. Excludes: overdue API/view/counters (post-v1 ticket T-008), public hosting/auth and pupil login.
Acceptance: Teacher finds, lends and returns; durable response precedes success UI. Retry/reload never duplicates mutation. Persistent browser recovery stores only token/action/resource IDs, never pupil labels or form payloads; resolved recovery records are cleared. Unsent/error form input stays in memory only and clears when resolved/cancelled.
Behaviour: Explicit loading, empty, error, success and uncertain-save states; input preserved in memory on failure; duplicate submissions prevented; unresolved token reconciled before retry.
Verification: HTTP/static tests plus documented manual keyboard and synthetic end-to-end journey including restart, injected save failure, reload recovery and browser storage cleanup. Prerequisites: T-003 search/API and T-004 lending; overdue is NOT a dependency. Assumptions: local teacher workstation; no frontend framework.
title: Teacher browser workflow and operating instructions
